verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's JS-scenario feature supports scripted form fills, clicks, and waits (e.g. clicking accept buttons, filling search fields) and premium/stealth proxies claim to bypass 'difficult to scrape websites,' plus cookie passing enables session/login persistence — these together partially satisfy the login/form-wall portion of the story. However there is no explicit documentation of automatic CAPTCHA-solving, and stealth_proxy is noted to be incompatible with some features (infinite_scroll), suggesting limits on its bypass robustness. Missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA-solving mechanism/claims, documented login-flow examples, and independent evidence confirming these bypass mechanisms work in practice.
